Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football 2026/27 Ghana League: Dreams beat Samartex to record consecutive wins for first time this season Source : Joy Sports 22 November 2026 5:20pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Dreams FC recorded consecutive victories in the Ghana Premier League for the first time this season after beating FC Samartex 1996 2-0 at the Tuba AstroTurf on Sunday.
The Still Believe lads secured all three points in their match week 12 encounter through goals from Hope Agbase and Shaban Mohammed, extending their unbeaten run to four matches.
Dreams broke the deadlock in the 29th minute when Agbase found the back of the net to give the hosts a deserved lead.
The home side carried their advantage into the break before Mohammed doubled their lead just two minutes after the restart, scoring in the 47th minute to put Dreams in a commanding position.
Samartex were unable to find a response as Dreams held on to secure a crucial victory and continue their recent resurgence.
The result marks a significant turnaround for Dreams, who endured a difficult start to the campaign, going eight matches without a win.
However, they have since found some consistency, winning three of their last four matches, with Sunday’s triumph representing their first back-to-back victories of the season.
Despite the improvement, Dreams remain 14th on the league table with 13 points after 12 matches.
Samartex, meanwhile, remain fifth with 19 points, having suffered their third defeat of the campaign.
Dreams will look to maintain their momentum when they travel to face Aduana FC in their next league fixture, while Samartex return home to host Port City.
